label: Wallet
depicts: Folded wallet with a front strap flap and a round snap button
use_when: Use when the interface wants a classic folded wallet with a visible fastening strap.
avoid_when: Do not use for pouches or open top wallets when the strap and snap are visible.

label: Wallet
depicts: Money pouch outline with a top ring and centered currency mark
use_when: Use when the interface wants a tied money pouch instead of a flat folding wallet.
avoid_when: Do not use for the rectangular wallet styles when the tied bag silhouette matters.

label: Wallet
depicts: Open top wallet outline with a back flap and one front dot
use_when: Use when the interface wants a flat wallet that looks open at the top edge.
avoid_when: Do not use for angled or clasp wallets when the top flap and front dot are the key cues.

label: Wallet
depicts: Angled wallet outline with a slanted flap and one front dot
use_when: Use when the interface wants a wallet shown in slight perspective with a lifted flap.
avoid_when: Do not use for the flat open wallet when the slanted flap angle should stay visible.

label: Wallet
depicts: Rounded rectangular wallet outline with a front slot panel and centered clasp notch
use_when: Use when the interface wants a compact wallet with a front slot and a centered clasp cutout.
avoid_when: Do not use for strap or pouch wallets when the front slot and clasp notch matter visually.
